See, the issue here, and youve already messed up madame, is that you are trying to justify this warusing whatever you have been told is the matter, replied Cahit as they finally made their way into the office, where a tea table had been laid out with pastries and tea. 
We are aware of the initial reasons, the xeno interference, the funding of the protests by Non-governmental actors from Rosenmarkke, we are your allies, we are privy to most of these things, we keep an eye on you, he said, But, with that decapitation strike, that is what we see to be the full issue, you see, our government believes that all regions are to tend to their own affairs with little interference, and Yzakastan has done so with this war since it started, He paused to sip the tea between his chubby fingers, But, he intoned lifting a finger in the air, There is no greater dishonour than killing the leader of another nation, he paused In Quran 2:190 the prophet, peace be unto him, says Fight in the way of Allah those who fight you but do not transgress, Indeed, Allah does not love transgressors. and once again Sunun Abu Dawud in his hadith says Fight in the name of Allah do not kill a child, nor a woman, nor an aged man. he paused once more to eat a pastry, before speaking once more Of course there are many medieval notables who argue in favor of a decapitation strike on the leadership, Ibn Qudmah, Al-nawawi, but those were extraordinary times when islam was under threat, he coughed a little before spreading his hands out in a dramatic fashion, In the Ali ibn Abi Talib it says, Do not fight them until they begin fighting you If they flee, do not pursue them; if they are wounded, do not finish them. It is thus that I tell you that your war entered an unlawful area, and I have consulted with my mufti and many of our own jurists on this matter, it entered unlawful area with that decapitation strike, because, Strømm proved no direct threat to your leadership,

He tapped a button on the side of his chair and the sound of whirring filled the room as the seat of the chair began to lift up slowly, Cahit continued puffing on his cigar as the seat lifted him to tower over the minister, he leaned forward, the chair creaking and he said, Yzakastan does not like it when the finances are interfered with, he wheezed, The shah is a very frugal man and he wants the national debt handled, he continued, So I will tell you this, we want updates from your government on what is going on with this war, and, if we do not like what is going on, then youll have to find another source of oilbecause we are a noble country, a proud country, and we do not take silly wars lightlyindeed I own this nations largest investment firm, if you do not believe me, check the stock market! he chortled patting his belly.
